raw_response:
I will keep most of my land in the wheat-maize rotation because that is the system I know best, it fits Quzhou County well, and with well irrigation I can manage it steadily. I have farmed for 30 years, so I do not want to take big risks at the start of the season. I will put 8 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, and I will keep 2.9 mu for cotton. For wheat and maize, I will use better seed and keep fertilizer at a moderate but reliable level so I can protect yield. For cotton, I will be a bit more cautious on fertilizer and irrigation, but I will still use improved seed and do more plant protection because cotton usually needs closer pest control. I will use rotary tillage because it is efficient for my scale and labor situation, especially since some family members work off-farm. My goal this year is stable production, manageable fieldwork, and dependable output rather than chasing the highest possible yield.
